name: Biomedical PDFs 1957-1987 — the 45 PDFs of the migraine corpus (first observation wave, August 2026)
source: PubMed Central / publisher PDFs, identified by PubMed identifier (file name = PMID)
selection: migraine literature 1957-1987 with a retrievable PDF; regime measured in form-045: 8 native, 36 with an OCR layer, 1 pure image
note: The PDFs are not redistributed; the identifier list is. The OCR layer read by the probes is the one embedded in the PDFs, extracted with pdftotext (poppler).
